description: Reconciled lambda=1.0, corrected-masking, 3-seed (42/123/456) comparison bundle across exact-protocol CLHR, SSA-style, tuned-STE, and post-hoc-KL. See RUN_LEDGER.md Section 2(k) for the original unreconciled discrepancy this closes.

42.note: SSA-style has no lambda_rca mixing; this is its natural-default config (alignment_weight=1.0, hard_probability=0.5, objective_clhr_weight unset), selected via the existing tune-then-heldout scripts (scripts/run_ssa_dev_queue.sh + scripts/run_ssa_heldout_queue.sh).

123.note: SSA-style has no lambda_rca mixing; this is its natural-default config (alignment_weight=1.0, hard_probability=0.5, objective_clhr_weight unset), selected via the existing tune-then-heldout scripts (scripts/run_ssa_dev_queue.sh + scripts/run_ssa_heldout_queue.sh).

456.note: SSA-style has no lambda_rca mixing; this is its natural-default config (alignment_weight=1.0, hard_probability=0.5, objective_clhr_weight unset), selected via the existing tune-then-heldout scripts (scripts/run_ssa_dev_queue.sh + scripts/run_ssa_heldout_queue.sh).

42.note: seed 42 is ste_tuning.py's own dev/tuning seed (lr=1e-3 winner); seeds 123/456 are ste_heldout.py --method ste runs at that same winning lr, G_CL computed by sparse_attention_cl_eval_single.py. Do NOT use results/s3/sparse_rca_ste_hard_s42.json -- that is a stale pre-tuning run at a different (wrong) learning rate.

123.note: seed 42 is ste_tuning.py's own dev/tuning seed (lr=1e-3 winner); seeds 123/456 are ste_heldout.py --method ste runs at that same winning lr, G_CL computed by sparse_attention_cl_eval_single.py. Do NOT use results/s3/sparse_rca_ste_hard_s42.json -- that is a stale pre-tuning run at a different (wrong) learning rate.

456.note: seed 42 is ste_tuning.py's own dev/tuning seed (lr=1e-3 winner); seeds 123/456 are ste_heldout.py --method ste runs at that same winning lr, G_CL computed by sparse_attention_cl_eval_single.py. Do NOT use results/s3/sparse_rca_ste_hard_s42.json -- that is a stale pre-tuning run at a different (wrong) learning rate.

dense.note: Launch DENSE_TRAIN_S{42,123,456} then DENSE_EVAL via vastai/launch_reconciled_lam10.sh, then pull with vastai/sync_reconciled_lam10_results.sh.

posthoc_kl.note: Launch POSTHOC_PREREQ_* (9 jobs) then POSTHOC_KL via vastai/launch_reconciled_lam10.sh.
